title: Independent State Evaluation & Cross-Lingual Grounding

expected_state_methodology.description: Independent expert adjudication using source passage retrieval, query intent analysis, cohort-scope verification, and benchmark answerability metadata. Controller predicted states were strictly excluded from expected-state assignment.

independent_verifier_models.model_observation: llama3.2:3b successfully verified cross-lingual Hindi/Hinglish semantic entailment against English evidence. qwen2.5:3b exhibited syntactic brittleness on code-mixed time-boundary phrases. Dual-model agreement was not treated as ground truth; human-in-the-loop audit arbitrated final semantic labels.

historical_phase2b_controller.notes: Severely depressed by Step 2 conflict over-assertion on 11 identical-rule cases.

cross_lingual_investigation.lexical_overlap_failure_diagnosis: Confirmed that character/token-level word overlap heuristics fail on cross-lingual Hindi and Hinglish claims evaluated against English documents. Lexical scores of 0.30 and 0.00 were false negatives; semantic entailment is 100% verified.

defects.title: Contradicted Claim Emission
defects.description: generator.py flags claim_supported=False in Citation, but emits raw contradictory text in QueryResponse.answer without suppression or redaction.

defects.title: Zero-Citation Grounding Bypass
defects.description: If LLM generates an ungrounded answer without [Source: ...] markers, generator.py returns citations=[] with ResponseStatus.ANSWERED, completely bypassing claim grounding.

defects.title: CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED Fallback to ANSWERED
defects.description: generator.py only handles CONFLICTING and PARTIAL, defaulting to ResponseStatus.ANSWERED when controller returns CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED.

known_limitations: Small-N unanswerable sample size (N_neg = 2) limits statistical generalizability of unanswerable metrics.
Local 3B parameter LLMs exhibit syntax sensitivity on code-mixed Hinglish time-boundary expressions.
Empirical Platt calibration and nested cross-validation remain deferred to Phase 3.
